title: Free trial
text:
## Free trial
Acme Notes offers a 14-day free trial. A credit card is not required to start the trial. The trial ends 14 days after signup.

title: Exporting notes
text:
## Exporting notes
Users can export notes as Markdown or PDF. Open Settings, choose Export, and select a format. If an export fails, the documented first step is to update the app and try again.

title: Security information
text:
## Security information
The available product notes do not specify an encryption algorithm or encryption-at-rest design. Contact the security team for current security documentation.

title: Syncing notes
text:
## Syncing notes
Acme Notes syncs changes when the device is online. The available notes do not specify a sync interval or offline conflict-resolution policy.

title: Refunds
text:
## Refunds
The available product notes do not describe refund eligibility, amounts, or processing times. Contact support for account-specific billing help.
